description: A red-haired young woman in a red puffer jacket, a knitted bobble hat and black snow trousers pulls a wooden sled up a snowy mountain slope in a snowstorm, with pine trees and a wooden cabin far behind. Three husky dogs wearing goggles sit on a tartan blanket in the sled, and another husky walks beside her on a lead. She stops, bends forward with her hands on her knees, breathing hard with clouds of breath, and then turns to look back at the dogs. A dropped mitten and a flask lie in the snow.

de.answer: Sie zieht einen Schlitten mit Hunden.
de.question: Was zieht die Frau?

es.answer: Está tirando de un trineo con perros.
es.question: ¿De qué está tirando la mujer?
